kindling.title: GLM-5.3

kindling.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B

configs.label: 1 Spark, drafter
configs.notes: Card recipe: DFlash LiLiCorr drafter, 7 tokens, 1 sequence, 1M context, stock clocks for the 8K/32K prefill (512-token bench: 25-26 tok/s single-stream decode). tg128 and the 2048 prefill are llama-benchy pp2048 + tg128 at depth 0, mean of 3 runs, GPU clock capped at 2000 MHz.

configs.label: 1 Spark, no drafter
configs.notes: --max-num-seqs 4, 1M context, stock clocks, 512-token decode, warm runs.

configs.label: TP=2, balanced
configs.notes: b12x MoE + linear, drafter 4 tokens, both Sparks capped at 2000 MHz. 512-token bench: prefill 3,314-3,372 tok/s at 8K and 3,300-3,314 at 32K; single-stream decode 43-44 tok/s prose, 59-74 code. tg128, 2048 prefill and concurrency are llama-benchy pp2048 + tg128 at depth 0 (concurrency with --max-num-seqs 16; mean TTFT at 10 requests 4.2 s).

configs.label: TP=2, decode
configs.notes: marlin MoE, drafter 4 tokens, both Sparks capped at 2000 MHz. 512-token bench: prefill 2,798-3,014 tok/s at 8K and 2,892-2,900 at 32K; single-stream decode 44-46 tok/s prose, 71-79 code. tg128, 2048 prefill and concurrency are llama-benchy pp2048 + tg128 at depth 0 (concurrency with --max-num-seqs 16; mean TTFT at 10 requests 5.4 s).
